title: The same data with the five-year cost computed for each supplier and the recommendation that follows from it (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv, math
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('suppliers.csv')))
t = open('memo.md').read()
for r in rows:
    n = math.ceil(1825 / int(r['cycle_life']))
    c = n * int(r['price_usd']) + (n - 1) * int(r['swap_labor_usd'])
    assert ('$%s |' % format(c, ',')) in t, (r['supplier'], c)
assert 'We recommend Volta' in t
